purpose: Keep candidate JavaScript out of the trusted node:test process while exercising the package root through a bounded JSON request/response boundary.

operations.call: Import the package root default ESM export and call it once with one JSON-compatible value. Return only a boolean result or a bounded exception record.
operations.inventory: Not used by the generic runner; package shape is checked by install/package validation and the default export call contract.

in_scope_values: finite and non-finite JSON-representable number values
